radisson-blu-da-nang.brand: Radisson Hotels (Radisson Hotel Group), upscale tier 'Radisson' (not Radisson Blu)
radisson-blu-da-nang.name_note: Property is Radisson Hotel Danang, NOT Radisson Blu. No rename found. Our slug/page title 'Radisson Blu Da Nang' and the CTA 'Considering Radisson Blu Resort Danang?' / 'Check Radisson Blu Resort Danang Prices' are wrong. Radisson Blu Resort Hoi An exists (Ha My Beach, Dien Ban, ~22 km from airport; official page says closed until further notice but booking sites list it as open: conflicting) but no Radisson Blu property was found inside Da Nang itself. Official Radisson URL slug is radisson-da-nang.
